next.reason: 1985: keys in 'order of decreasing significance without regard to how they are divided into KEY phrases'; ASCENDING lowest to highest, DESCENDING highest to lowest 'according to the rules for comparison of operands in a relation condition'. 2023 says the same: §2023:14.9.40.4 GR2 'without regard to their association with ASCENDING or DESCENDING phrases'; §2023:14.9.40.4 GR8 compares 'according to the rules for comparison of operands in a relation condition', 'lower value is returned first' for ASCENDING, higher for DESCENDING; §2023:14.9.40.4 GR1 ties each key to its ASCENDING/DESCENDING word.
